mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT type FROM unified_apply_template ORDER BY type
SELECT field_key, label FROM approval_render_dialogform WHERE type = #{type}

SELECT FR.field_key as fieldKey, FR.relation_type as type, FR.relation_key as relationKey, CASE WHEN FR.relation_type = 'rate' THEN ( SELECT JSON_OBJECT( 'showText', RA.showText, 'texts', RA.texts, 'colors', RA.colors ) FROM field_rate_config RA WHERE RA.field_key = FR.relation_key ) WHEN FR.relation_type IN ('select', 'radio', 'checkbox') THEN ( SELECT JSON_OBJECT( 'option', SE.option ) FROM field_select_config SE WHERE SE.field_key = FR.relation_key ) WHEN FR.relation_type = 'upload' THEN ( SELECT JSON_OBJECT( 'actionURL', UP.actionURL, 'limit', UP.limit, 'texts', UP.texts ) FROM field_upload_config UP WHERE UP.field_key = FR.relation_key ) END as config FROM field_relations FR WHERE FR.relation_type = #{type}
